documents.title: Notice Of 18Th Annual General Meeting Of The Company.

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers reported a 60% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 121 crores for Q1 FY27, driven by strong performance in both retail and wholesale segments. The company is actively expanding its retail footprint in Gujarat, with four store launches planned across Surat, Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar during Q2 and Q3 FY27. Management aims to progressively shift its sales mix towards retail while transitioning inventory funding towards Gold Metal Loans to lower interest costs. Manufacturing capacity utilization currently stands at ~50% and is expected to reach 70-90% during the peak seasonal quarter. RBZ Jewellers reported a 60% year-on-year increase in revenue for Q1 FY27, driven by robust customer demand and higher jewellery sales.

guidance.claim: Management expects the B2B to B2C sales mix to reach 50-50 in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term.
guidance.quote: For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: The company expects 18-karat jewellery to represent at least 20% of its corporate sales mix by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: So we have introduced this since December, our sales mix in corporate, before it was 100% 22 carat, I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

guidance.claim: Management expects its debt-to-equity ratio to remain below 1:1 by the end of the current financial year.
guidance.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting maximum utilisation of its existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

guidance.claim: The company's retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms planned for Surat by Q2 and Rajkot by early Q3.
guidance.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

guidance.claim: The company is not providing forward guidance for the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: There is no guidance for this year, frankly saying.

guidance.claim: Management is reserving guidance for the year due to recent government announcements.
guidance.quote: I think in the scenarios like this, we would really not give out the guidance for this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted good demand in July, steady trends in August, and positive reception at IIJS.
demand_outlook.quote: So July has been good. August so far has been right. IIJS has gone good, but still we would not want to really comment on numbers.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand outlook for Quarter 2 appears promising as the company enters the period.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year due to robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's growth momentum was supported by festive demand, particularly during the Akshay Tritiya season.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth momentum was supported by festive demand, particularly during Akshay Tritiya season.

demand_outlook.claim: The month of April has been very good for the company.
18 carat gold is gaining more growth than 22 carat gold.
demand_outlook.quote: 18 carat is generally picked up more in terms of growth, 18 carat is gaining more growth than 22 carat.

capex_expansion.claim: RBZ Jewellers plans to launch its Surat store in Quarter 2 and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores feature around 10,000 square feet carpet area while mid-format stores are around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment is typically INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores for large format stores and around INR 50 crores for small format stores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores. While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects store capex break-even to be achieved in a year or less.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand its retail footprint with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand its retail presence in Surat and Rajkot, with both showrooms targeted to commence operations by Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open four stores within the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: But as of now, in this calendar year, 4 stores is what is coming up, 2 large and 2 mid.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached INR 18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Stagnant average gold rates resulted in negligible inventory gain during Quarter 1.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly margins were affected by lease asset amortization of INR 76 lakhs and lease liabilities impact of INR 115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The company is able to garner better margins than its peers due to its manufacturing setup and presence across both wholesale and retail segments.
margins_costs.quote: Because of our manufacturing setup and presence across both wholesale and retail segment, we are able to garner better margins than our peers.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the financial year 2026 improved to 14.44%, representing an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margins are around 12% to 14% for retail and 7% to 8% for wholesale.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, retail would be around 12% or 14% GP. Wholesale will be around 7% to 8% GP.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's factory capacity stands at 1.8 to 2 tons per year and is currently operating at around 50% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year. And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During peak season periods, factory capacity utilization ranges from 70% to 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the season times, currently as of now, our capacity utilization generally goes at 70%, 80% minimum, 75%, 85% sometimes, depending on which days are all, sometimes it is near to 90% or so.

orders_capacity.claim: Job work services accounted for 52% of the total gold volumes sold in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Accounted for 52% of total gold volumes sold in FY26, highlighting its strategic importance to the business.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity utilization is approximately 50% to 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company launched 730 new designs during the quarter, averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio,

capital_allocation.claim: RBZ Jewellers has sanctioned debt facilities of around INR 300 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Sanctioned debt limits remain unutilized and are sufficient to fund the four upcoming store expansions in this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to progressively transition its inventory financing towards Gold Metal Loans to keep inventory hedged.
capital_allocation.quote: GML we are planning that during the course of the journey we should actually have an inventory which is hedged.

capital_allocation.claim: The job work segment enables an asset-light business model by minimizing investment in gold inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: Enables an asset-light business model by minimizing investment in gold inventory while supporting demand fulfillment.

capital_allocation.claim: The company will explore Gold Metal Loans in this financial year for buying gold for upcoming stores.
capital_allocation.quote: So we will be exploring GML in this financial year perhaps for buying -- the new buying of gold that will happen for the upcoming stores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company anticipates about INR125 crores to INR150 crores of inventory for each new store.
capital_allocation.quote: We anticipate about INR125 crores to INR150 crores of inventory for each store.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not anticipate any dilution to fund the upcoming stores.
capital_allocation.quote: No. I think the raise of debt plus inventory transfer, plus the profit gain would actually suffice it.

risks_headwinds.claim: Carrying inventory in an unhedged open position poses commodity price risks to ongoing business operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now what you talk about the inventory levels, it is a directional call that we have taken that on an ongoing business if we were to, put our inventory and this amount of inventory onto, let's say in an open position, it is going to call for risk.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company notes that recent restrictions on gold imports are not advantageous.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry sentiment and buying remain low in late quarter 1 post Akshay Tritiya.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now when you talk about the industry quarter 1 post Akshay Tritiya remains low in terms of sentiments and all in the buying -- there is no buying season as such in late quarter 1.
